title: Performance Intelligence & NIC Tuning Update
headline: Smarter issue detection, live network monitoring, and several critical bug fixes including a black screen fix on launch.
changes: Fixed black screen on launch caused by a missing icon import in the sidebar (Network icon for NIC Tuning)
Fixed splash screen exit animation causing a GPU layer occlusion in the packaged app
Detected Issues panel no longer false-flags SwitchControl's own Max Performance power plan as a problem
Added 6 new system health detections: CPU temperature, GPU temperature, VRAM saturation, low disk space, Resizable BAR disabled, and WiFi-only gaming
Added live RX/TX throughput graph with sparkline chart to the NIC Tuning page
Fixed power plan setup flashing a UAC prompt for users already running as administrator
Prevented dashboard intelligence polling from firing before login completes
Installed app name now permanently displays as Switchcontrol with no version suffix
